# E-M10 per-sector Hue/Saturation/Lightness, version 56

The owner reports the 12-sector colour editor visible and effective in photos on their E-M10 Mark I.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 (Mark I)](../cameras/em10.md) · **Project:** [om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M10 firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-1400.md) · **Mod build:** 56

In version 56 on firmware 1.4, Hue, Saturation and Lightness can be set for 12 named colour sectors, and the owner reports the effect visible in photos.

**Availability:** published release. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M10 version 56: owner field test](../evidence/em10-v56-owner.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; release label only.

## Limits

- The editor's field test is reported for version 46; version 56 carries it with per-bank rows, and the owner reports 56 working well.
- One owner camera; the open freeze-and-reboot report with filters is not linked to this editor.
